title: OfferSearchResponse
description: Contract for ranked offers and map businesses. Mirrors DealsSeeker.Shared.Contracts.Offers.SearchOffersResponse. Spec IDs: OFFERS.SEARCH.001, OFFERS.SEARCH.SMART.001, OFFERS.SEARCH.PAGINATION.001, OFFERS.FEED.PROMOTED.001, OFFERS.FAVORITES.001, OFFERS.REPORTED.DEMOTION.001, OFFERS.PHOTOS.CAROUSEL.001, OFFERS.LIST.ACTIONS.001

offers.description: Offers belonging to the requested page only.

businesses.description: Map markers for the full filtered result set, not limited to the requested page.

page.description: Effective 1-based page index of the returned offers.

pageSize.description: Effective maximum number of offers returned in one page.

hasMore.description: Indicates whether further pages exist for the same query and radius.
